## UI polish: PlanBar 15 fixes across Spacing, Typography, Contrast, Hierarchy, States, Motion and Tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `gap-[10px]` is off the scale. Now `gap-[var(--space-12)]`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Spacing**: `p-[13px]` on the bar is off the scale. Now `p-[var(--space-12)]`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Spacing**: `px-[7px]` on both buttons is off the scale. Now `px-[var(--space-8)]`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Spacing**: `py-[3px]` on both buttons is off the scale. Now `py-[var(--space-4)]`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **Typography**: `text-[15px]` is off the type scale and under the 16 px body minimum. Now `text-[length:var(--font-size-md)]`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 6. **Typography**: the "Trial ends in 3 days" text had no line-height. Now `leading-[var(--line-height-body)]`. (R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 7. **Contrast**: `text-gray-400` (#9ca3af) on #ffffff is 2.54:1. Now `text-[color:var(--color-text-muted)]` (#4a6462), 6.38:1. (R-ui-polish-4, R-ui-polish-20) 8. **Hierarchy**: "Upgrade plan" is the primary action. `bg-blue-600 text-white` is now `bg-[var(--color-action-primary-bg)] text-[color:var(--color-action-primary-text)]`. The raw blue was replaced by the project's primary-fill token. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-21) 9. **Hierarchy**: "Remind me later" was a second filled button with the same style. Now it is secondary: `bg-transparent`, `text-[color:var(--color-action-secondary-text)]` and a `border-[length:var(--border-width-hairline)] border-[color:var(--color-action-secondary-border)]` outline. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-20) 10. **States**: neither button had a hover style. Now the primary has `hover:bg-[var(--color-action-primary-bg-hover)] active:bg-[var(--color-action-primary-bg-pressed)]` and the secondary has `hover:bg-[var(--color-selected-bg)]`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 11. **States**: neither button had a focus style. Now both have `focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-[length:var(--border-width-focus)] focus-visible:outline-[color:var(--color-border-focus)] focus-visible:outline-offset-2`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 12. **States**: neither button had a disabled style. Now both have `disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed`. (R-ui-polish-6) 13. **States**: the buttons were about 24 px tall with no size minimum. Now both have `min-h-[var(--size-target-min)] min-w-[var(--size-target-min)]`. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 14. **Motion**: the new hover change had no transition. Now `transition-colors duration-[var(--duration-base)] ease-[var(--ease-standard)]`, turned off with `motion-reduce:transition-none`. (R-ui-polish-9, R-ui-polish-20) 15. **Tokens**: the bar used raw values where tokens match. `bg-white` is now `bg-[var(--color-surface-default)]` and `rounded` (4 px) is now `rounded-[var(--radius-sm)]`. (R-ui-polish-20) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Trial ends in 3 days | #9ca3af on #ffffff, 2.54:1 | `--color-text-muted` (#4a6462) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 6.38:1 | | Upgrade plan | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--color-action-primary-bg` (#0f766e), 5.47:1 | | Upgrade plan, hover | none | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--color-action-primary-bg-hover` (#0c403c), 11.58:1 | | Remind me later | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | `--color-action-secondary-text` (#0f766e) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 5.47:1 | | Remind me later, hover | none | `--color-action-secondary-text` (#0f766e) on `--color-selected-bg` (#f0fdfc), 5.25:1 | Ratios computed with the contrast script. ### Polished code ```jsx export function PlanBar({ onUpgrade, onSkip }) { return (
Trial ends in 3 days
); } ``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word. - Brand hue kept: `--color-brand` / `--color-primary-800` (#0f766e). - Component name, props and `onClick` handlers. - Token file: not edited. ### Open questions - None.
